metadata.title: Features — CFD/FDS computing in the cloud | FDSRun
metadata.description: FDS on dedicated servers, automatic hardware sizing, a cost estimator, live result previews and full result downloads. All without infrastructure of your own.

cloudFeatures.title: Everything you need to run CFD
cloudFeatures.lead: You upload an FDS file, we pick the server, run the solver and hand back the results. No infrastructure of your own, no waiting in a university cluster queue, no tying up your laptop for hours.

items.f1Desc: Run the Fire Dynamics Simulator solver on dedicated servers — no installation, no MPI configuration, no limits imposed by your own hardware.
items.f2Desc: The system reads the mesh and core count from your .fds file and picks a machine to match. You never pay for cores you cannot use.
items.f3Desc: Before anything starts, upload the file and see the estimated runtime and cost within seconds. The estimate runs in your browser, no account needed.
items.f4Desc: DEVC/HRR charts and slice planes update while the solver runs — you can tell whether the scenario is heading the right way long before it finishes.
items.f5Desc: Smokeview files, CSVs and slices download straight from storage — individually or zipped, split into parts for large result sets.
items.f6Desc: Every job with its price, runtime and status in one place. Enter your invoicing details once and they apply to every settlement.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: FDS input files with the .fds extension. We read the &MESH, &TIME and &REAC sections plus model elements (&OBST, &VENT, &DEVC) directly in your browser.
faq.q2: What does it cost and when do I pay?
faq.a2: You pay for actual compute time and result storage — no subscription, no standing fees. You see the estimated cost before the run starts, and payment (Stripe, BLIK, Przelewy24) happens after the computation finishes. A VAT invoice is available in your account.
faq.q3: How long does a run take?
faq.a3: It depends on the cell count and the simulated duration. We show a runtime estimate with the quote, based on the CFL condition and a throughput of ~240,000 cell-timesteps/s per core. Every job gets its own dedicated compute server.
faq.q4: Can I run several simulations at once?
faq.a4: Yes. Each job starts a separate virtual machine — there is no queue and no resource sharing between your simulations.
faq.a5: The file is analysed locally in your browser and uploaded only after you accept the quote. The computation runs on servers in the European Union, and the machine is destroyed once the job finishes.

interrupted.title: The computation stopped without any error message.
interrupted.body: The log contains no FDS error, and the machine stopped responding before the simulation finished. This usually means a compute-machine failure on the infrastructure side.

The Website automatically collects only the information contained in cookies. It does not automatically collect any other information about Users.

sections.lead: Cookies are computer data, in particular small text files, stored on the User's end device (computer, smartphone, tablet) and intended for use with the Website. Cookies usually contain the name of the site they come from, how long they are stored on the device, and a unique number.
The Website uses the following types of cookies:
items: Essential (technical) cookies: strictly necessary for the site to work correctly. They provide basic security and availability functions.
Analytical / performance cookies: allow information to be collected about how the site is used, which helps us improve its structure and content (e.g. Google Analytics).
Functional cookies: allow the User's chosen settings to be remembered and the interface personalised (e.g. the selected light/dark mode).
Most web browsers allow cookies to be stored on the User's end device by default.

The User may change their cookie settings at any time. Settings can be changed to block automatic handling of cookies in the browser settings, or to notify the User each time a cookie is placed on the device.
Detailed information about handling cookies is available in the settings of your software (web browser), e.g. Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge.
Restricting the use of cookies may affect some functionality available on the Website (e.g. dark mode preference will not be remembered).
More information about how your personal data is processed can be found in our Privacy Policy.
If you have questions about this cookie policy, please write to biuro@fp-solutions.pl.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy provides general information about the processing of personal data of website visitors and clients using the services of Fire Protection Solutions. It has been prepared on the basis of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 (GDPR).

items: The controller of your personal data is Fire Protection Solutions Jakub Baran, registered address: ul. Grzybowa 7A lok. 2, 05-825 Grodzisk Mazowiecki, Poland.
The company is entered in the Polish Central Register and Information on Economic Activity (CEIDG), VAT ID (NIP): 6182094888, statistical number (REGON): 528892780.
For matters relating to personal data protection you can contact the controller by email at biuro@fp-solutions.pl.

sections.h: § 2. Purposes, legal bases and retention periods
sections.lead: The controller processes personal data for the following purposes:
items: Contact and handling enquiries – under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (the controller's legitimate interest). Data (e.g. name, surname, email, phone number) is processed in order to answer enquiries sent through the form or by email. It is kept for as long as handling the enquiry requires.

Delivery of fire safety engineering services (including fire safety manuals, CFD simulations, audits and fire protection reports) – under Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (necessary for performance of a contract). Data is processed for the duration of the contract and until claims arising from it become time-barred.

Compliance with legal obligations (accounting, tax) – under Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Data is kept for the period required by generally applicable law (usually 5 years from the end of the calendar year in which the tax payment deadline fell).

sections.lead: To operate the site and deliver fire safety services, the controller uses external providers. Data may be shared with:
items: the accounting office serving the controller;
hosting and email service providers;
providers of business and engineering project management software;
state authorities (e.g. the tax office) where required by applicable law.
sections.note: The controller entrusts data only to entities that guarantee the appropriate data protection and security measures required by law.

sections.lead: Under the GDPR every User has:
items: the right to access their data and obtain a copy of it;
the right to rectify (correct) their data;
the right to erasure (where there is no basis for continued processing);
the right to restrict processing;
the right to data portability;
the right to object to processing based on the controller's legitimate interest.
sections.note: Users also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority — the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO) — if they believe their data is being processed unlawfully.

sections.lead: The controller applies appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect the personal data processed, proportionate to the risks and the categories of data concerned. In particular, data is protected against disclosure to unauthorised persons, removal by an unauthorised person, processing in breach of applicable law, and alteration, loss, damage or destruction (including through the use of SSL certificates on the site).

The website automatically collects only the information contained in cookies. They serve the correct operation of the site as well as statistical and analytical purposes. Detailed rules on the use and management of cookies are described in a separate document: the Cookie Policy.

The controller reserves the right to amend this Privacy Policy. Changes may follow from developments in web technology, changes in generally applicable law, and the evolution of the fire safety engineering services provided. Users will be informed of any changes in a visible and comprehensible manner on this page.
